extracted.intended_audience: publishers and publishing professionals submitting children's and young-adult books for the Boston Globe–Horn Book Awards
extracted.subtask_description: Submission guidelines for publishers to enter books in the 2025–2026 Boston Globe–Horn Book Awards, including eligibility windows, acceptable editions/formats, categories, submission format, deadlines, and possible committee requests.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publication date eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Books must be published in the United States between June 1, 2025, and May 31, 2026.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: First U.S. editions of books previously published elsewhere are eligible. Note the listed publication window is distinct from the submission-acceptance deadline (see deadline criterion).

rubrics_metrics.name: Editions and formats excluded or ineligible
rubrics_metrics.description: Reissued editions, textbooks, e-books, and audiobooks will not be considered, nor will manuscripts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Despite this exclusion, the guidelines also say 'Simultaneous submissions of available audiobook downloads would be welcome' — interpret audiobook files as supplementary materials for consideration by judges rather than primary eligible entries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Categories for consideration
rubrics_metrics.description: Judges will select one winner and may designate up to two honor books in each of the following categories: Fiction and Poetry; Nonfiction; Picture Book.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Entries should be submitted with an awareness of these three distinct award categories; selection may include one winner and up to two honors in each category.

rubrics_metrics.name: Who should submit / publisher preference
rubrics_metrics.description: Books should be submitted by publishers, although the judges reserve the right to honor any eligible book.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: While publishers are the expected submitters, the committee can select any book that meets eligibility criteria whether or not it was submitted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Number of submissions per publisher / quality advisory
rubrics_metrics.description: There is no limit on the number of titles a publisher may submit, but publishers are urged to use their best judgment and send only those titles that they believe are distinguished enough to warrant consideration.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is both a procedural rule (no numeric limit) and an evaluative expectation (submitters should self-filter by quality).

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission format and required metadata
rubrics_metrics.description: Publishers should submit books in pdf form via email and 'Please clearly indicate BGHB Award submissions in the subject line and include a complete list of all submitted titles with their publication dates.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Send to specified email addresses (bghb at hbook.com and kflynn at hbook.com). Include a complete list of submitted titles with publication dates; simultaneous audiobook downloads would be welcome as supplementary material.

rubrics_metrics.name: Acceptance deadline / no extensions
rubrics_metrics.description: Publishers are urged to send their submissions as soon as possible after publication. No books will be accepted after May 15, 2026. There will be no extensions to this deadline.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Although the publication eligibility window runs through May 31, 2026, the submission acceptance cutoff is May 15, 2026 — submit early to avoid disqualification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Committee request for physical copies
rubrics_metrics.description: In early 2026, the committee may contact publishers to request physical copies of specific titles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Publishers should be prepared to provide physical copies upon request even if the initial submission is electronic.

rubrics_metrics.name: Announcement and awards timeline
rubrics_metrics.description: Winners and Honor Books will be announced in June 2026. The awards ceremony will be held in the fall of 2026.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Timetable for results and ceremony; entrants should expect notifications around those dates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contact and administrative information
rubrics_metrics.description: For more information, contact the Boston Globe–Horn Book Awards administrator at bghb at hbook.com; specific contacts named include Kari Brabander, Kitty Flynn, Adrienne L. Pettinelli.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use provided contact emails for submission questions or administrative matters; include 'BGHB Award submissions' in subject lines when emailing submissions.
